decisions.reason: The bathroom partition strategy does not change the required dwelling count of three.
The source concerns walls separating bathrooms and does not change Unit 1's kitchen configuration or cabinet dimensions.
The bathroom remains required with its position to be indicated; the cross-unit wall-reuse strategy is already owned by the partition-wall Requirement and does not invalidate this state.
The source concerns bathroom-separating walls and does not alter Unit 3's kitchen concept or cabinet dimensions.
The source does not change whether Unit 3 requires a bathroom; its partition-wall strategy remains independently represented by the source Requirement.
Reusing existing walls for bathroom partitions does not change the requirement to position bathrooms with respect to existing toilet-pipe locations.
The sketch already requires separation walls to be shown; the source refines the partition design without changing the sketch's artifact type, purpose, or required-content categories.
The source concerns bathroom-separating walls and does not change Unit 2's kitchen concept or cabinet dimensions.
